posts.title: 5,009 failed SSH logins in a week: how we locked down our servers
posts.description: 5,009 failed SSH logins in a week. How we moved SSH behind Tailscale, set up Hetzner's stateless firewall, fixed Docker bypassing ufw, and tested our backups.

posts.title: MCP output schemas can break clients on edge runtimes
posts.description: Adding outputSchema to our MCP tools broke mcp.so's tool fetch. The v1 TypeScript SDK client compiles schemas with Ajv, which edge runtimes ban. The fix.

posts.title: Claude edited my last three YouTube videos in DaVinci Resolve
posts.description: Claude edited three of my YouTube videos in DaVinci Resolve 21.1. Raw footage to final cut, the A/B picks, what broke, and what still needs me.
